provenance.method: Reviewed current NHS inform insomnia guidance and Scotland clinical handoff on 2026-09-05.

name: NHS inform — insomnia (Scotland)
description: NHS inform guidance on insomnia symptoms, possible causes, CBT-I/self-help context and when to contact a GP practice.
intended_use: Scotland-specific public clinical starting point for persistent or impactful sleep difficulty.
audience_or_context: Scotland; people seeking NHS information about insomnia and routes to appropriate clinical help.
limitations: ND Oracle cannot diagnose insomnia or another sleep disorder.
Medication decisions remain clinician/pharmacist-led and are outside ND Oracle authority.
cost_or_access_notes: Free public NHS information; local treatment/service availability varies.
